chunk_map.heading: It reads the whole conversation every time

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 4: "That's context." (closest) — 'That' resolves to the sentence just before in the same chunk; header 'It' resolves to Claude named in line 4 of the same slide. Nothing never-named, vague or stranded.

rules_evaluated.na_reason: no pointer to another file or earlier deck position

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no "the X you did/saw" backward reference

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.

rules_evaluated.evidence: line 4-6: slide carries a full self-contained claim (whole conversation is the input; that is context).

line 1 header "It reads the whole conversation every time" vs line 4 "It reads the whole conversation every time and generates the next response" — body states exactly the header; closest risk is bare "It" resolved in the first body sentence.

line 6: "every useful thing in this training is built on this one idea" — closest to a self-grading superlative but it is a scope claim about the idea, not a rating of the move; no Not-X-Not-Y, no triple, no number, no noun stack, no verb triplet.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep dialect terms (surface-noun, compendium, beat, mood, firing, forcing function) -> 0 in 6-line body; "context" is ordinary engineering vocabulary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c "\*\*" -> 0; only italic *part of the input* (line 4), no bold.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: shared slide file; composed-deck presence is a host-module concern, no layout-affecting markup in this file

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase/Step headers or hand-numbered headers

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -ciE "below|above|see below|further down|at the top" -> 0; scripts/check-slide-deixis.js reports nothing for this file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: In-deck links work now; whether they EARN their place is open.
Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-size.js --file -> "every slide is within limits"; wc -w 75 words, 0 bullets.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 1: "It reads the whole conversation every time" — lecture heading is a claim, as the rule requires.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: line 6: "Unglamorous, isn't it? And yet every useful thing in this training is built on this one idea." — nearest to an aphorism kicker, but it adds the load-bearing weight claim for the term and does not restate the header.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no header rename in play; single slide whose body answers its header

notes: Slide file, single chunk. Host-deck fit (rule 1 antecedent for Claude, placement after any prior slide) is judged on the sequence in the including file.
